sourceDescription: NMC letter D-11011/500/2024-AcademicCell dated 12-09-2024 with CBME Curriculum 2024 and competency volumes; Physiology (CODE: PY) table read at text offsets 150000-250000 of 801400.
verification: Official NMC document text read through a web reader that quotes short rows and restates long rows. PDF bytes, the pinned SHA-256, sourceBodySha256 values, rendered pages and table-cell alignment were not independently verified. Identity of this file with the pinned source PDF is assumed from title and date, not proven. No source prose stored.
modeRule: Practical draft mode expected when the official level is SH or P; knowledge mode otherwise.
scope: All 131 Physiology references that lacked selected review evidence at the checked head (PY1.1-PY12.10; PY4.12, PY5.16 and PY6.12 already reviewed; PY9.1 is an official-replacement source exception and PY10.10 is an accepted-private canonical identity candidate (spinal cord transection patterns)).
observations: PY9.1 and PY10.10 are outside the names-only index. PY9.1 is an official-replacement source exception (2026-11-13-nmc-source-exception-current-branch-checkpoint.json). PY10.10 is one of the 12 accepted-private canonical identity candidates (2026-11-12-nmc-full-index-coverage-and-canonical-candidates.json). Corrected 2026-11-16: an earlier version placed PY10.10 in the source-exception track.
Topic 5 header states 3 certifiable competencies while rows PY5.14-PY5.16 show 3, 1 and 1.
limits: Editorial scope comparison only; no clinical, faculty, rights or canonical acceptance.
The 154-reference original hold inventory is unchanged.
certificationCountReported values are reader-reported and need a rendered-page check before use.
